title: Update GitHub prompts, copilot instructions, and AI agent configurations

subtasks.content: Update `.github/copilot-instructions.md`: remove Python 3.9+, pytest, Black, flake8, mypy, pygls, pip, setuptools, pyproject.toml references from Development Environment, Testing, and Folder Structure sections; replace with TypeScript/Mocha/ESLint/Prettier equivalents
Remove `Bash(pytest:*)`, `Bash(python:*)`, and the hardcoded PowerShell `test_paradox_checks.py` permission entry from `.claude/settings.local.json`

Delete `.github/skills/pytest-testing-patterns` and create `.github/skills/mocha-testing-patterns` with TypeScript/Mocha testing patterns (describe/it/assert, beforeEach setup, async patterns) derived from existing unit tests in `vscode-extension/src/test/unit/`
Update `.github/skills/lsp-feature-debugging`: replace pytest reproducer patterns and `@pytest.mark.asyncio` with Mocha test patterns and TypeScript debugging steps
Update `.github/skills/ck3-validation-debugging`: replace `def test_specific_validation_issue()` pytest patterns with TypeScript/Mocha equivalents
Update `.github/skills/lsp-performance-optimization`: replace `cProfile`/`memory_profiler`/`pytest-benchmark` references with Node.js profiling tools and Mocha-based performance test patterns
Update `.github/skills/tool-list.md`: remove Python environment tool entries (`configure_python_environment`, `install_python_packages`, Pylance MCP tools)
Rewrite `.github/prompts/Test Writing Best Practices.prompt.md` from pytest to TypeScript/Mocha with describe/it/assert.strictEqual/assert.deepStrictEqual patterns matching project conventions
Update `.github/prompts/Debugging LSP Server Issues.prompt.md`: replace `pytest tests/ -v` and `python -m pychivalry.server` with TypeScript equivalents (`npm test`, `npm run test:unit`)
Update `.github/prompts/Adding New CK3 Language Features.prompt.md`: replace `def test_*()`, `@pytest.mark.integration`, `@pytest.mark.asyncio` examples with Mocha describe/it patterns
Update `.github/prompts/LSP Feature Implementation.prompt.md`: replace pygls handler patterns and pytest test structure with TypeScript LSP provider and Mocha test examples
Update `.github/prompts/Branch Merge Assistant.prompt.md`: replace `pytest tests/ -v`, `flake8 pychivalry/`, `mypy pychivalry/` final checks with `npm run lint`, `npm run format-check`, `npm test`

Update `.github/prompts/Version Update Assistant.prompt.md`: remove `pyproject.toml`, `pychivalry/__init__.py`, `python -m build`, `pip install` references; keep only `vscode-extension/package.json` and VSIX packaging
Update `.github/prompts/documentation_standard.md`: replace Python docstring templates (module/function/class) with TSDoc/JSDoc conventions matching project style
Update `.github/prompts/architecture_and_flow.md`: replace pytest references in testing strategy section with Mocha testing patterns
Verify: grep all files in `.github/`, `kanban-development-guideline.md`, and `.claude/settings.local.json` for residual Python/pytest/pygls/flake8/mypy/Black references; fix any remaining occurrences
